title: X Tweet Scraper storage
description: The run summary a caller should read, kept separate from the internal checkpoint they should not need to.

runSummary.title: Run summary
runSummary.description: Written at the end of every run: requested vs fetched vs pushed, whether the free-tier cap applied and why, selectivity, tokens consumed, error counts and estimated cost per 1k results.

checkpoint.title: Crawl checkpoint (internal)
checkpoint.description: Per-account cursors, the global seen-set and buffered results, persisted so a migrated or resurrected run resumes rather than restarts. Not part of the output contract — and deliberately not trusted for the free-tier counter, which is floored on the dataset's own item count.
